title: Ship's gh api calls for another repository run with the default App token scope
body: scoped() adds KRN_APP_REPOSITORY only when args carry --repo; `gh api repos/<repo>/...` names the repo only in the path, so branches, rules and check-runs reads use the wrong token (src/ci/ship.ts:278-282, 210-219, 855-860). Same class as closed t-h8111g4.

Evidence: an external Gemini audit (2026-11-20) wrote the reproduction .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d1-*.test.ts; it fails by assertion on main 1856e2d, and an independent krn-reader pass confirmed the premise and the expected behaviour against the source.
Outcome: the reproduction becomes the regression test at the lowest layer that shows the defect (KRN-14) and passes; the fix names the defect class in Root cause and Redesign lines (KRN-15).

Files: src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts
Proof: node --test .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d1-ship-api-scope.test.ts fails by assertion on the base and passes after the fix
